segments: A typical flake.nix is an attribute set in which outputs is a function that takes inputs and returns an output attribute set.
inputs contains the external resources you want to reference.

The follows keyword: very important! It makes a specified nested input follow the top-level nixpkgs, reducing duplicate nixpkgs sources in the dependency graph. Multiple package versions may still exist, and sharing an input does not guarantee compatibility across all external projects.
nixosConfigurations: used by nixos-rebuild; your system is at its core.
self: represents the current Flake itself. You can use it to reference files defined within it.
@inputs: syntactic sugar that captures all input arguments together.
Practical tip: understand the outputs hierarchy
Running nix flake show displays the outputs as a tree. Those levels must match exactly in your code for nixos-rebuild to find your configuration.
